facts.fact: Founded in 1950 when 25-year-old Tosaku Nishida started Tsuzawa Knit Fabric Manufacture in Oyabe City, Toyama Prefecture, Japan; the Goldwin brand itself launched in 1958.
Built its name on skiwear: functional ski sweaters in the 1960s, official supplier to the Swedish national ski team from 1987, and sponsor of the British Alpine Ski Team since 2017.
Goldwin is the company behind The North Face in Japan: it began marketing The North Face in 1978 and acquired the Japan and South Korea trademark rights in 1995.

Golf runs deep: a USPGA golf wear license and U.S. Open Golf line (1980-81), the Goldwin Cup Japan vs USA Golf Match (1983), Golf Club Goldwin in Oyabe (1991), Goldwin Golf Club USA in California (1994), and official supplier to the U.S. Open and U.S. Senior Open (1997).
In 2013 its subsidiary Black & White Sportswear launched "and per se", a dedicated golf apparel brand (Japan market; not sold on the US store).
Launched the Goldwin lifestyle collection in FW16 and its outdoor and athletic collections in 2019; Goldwin 0, an experimental technical platform, launched in 2022.
First US store opened in San Francisco in 2019; a New York flagship opened in April 2026.

quotes.quote: The resulting apparel can withstand the toughest outdoor conditions while still looking great in urban environments.
Harmony with nature can, and should, be heightened by the clothes you wear.

products.name: Floating Wind Shell Half Zip Pullover
products.stock: In stock: Black 3-5, Sleet Gray 4-5, Opal Green 2-5 (Goldwin sizes 1-5)
products.colors: Black, Sleet Gray, Opal Green (others sold out)
features: Lightweight 100% polyester with a balance of wind resistance and breathability; water repellent, withstands light rain
Body and sleeves cut slightly wider for mobility; packs into included stuff sack
products.golf_note: A half-zip wind shirt you can swing in: wider sleeves, longer back that will not ride up at the top of the backswing, and it stuffs into its own sack once the morning wind drops.

products.name: Airly Shell Packable Wind Jacket
products.stock: In stock: After Dark 2-5, Red Carnelian 4-5
features: Goldwin's original 10-denier ripstop with reinforced high-strength yarns; water-repellent finish
Forward-set sleeves for freedom of movement; double-slider zip; packs into the hood pocket
products.golf_note: Forward-set sleeves are the golf detail here. Full-zip wind layer for a 40-degree first tee, then it folds into its own hood pocket and lives in the bag.

products.name: PERTEX UNLIMITED 2L Jacket
products.stock: In stock: Black 2 & 5, Kokiran Green 3-5, Sand Land 2-5
products.colors: Black, Kokiran Green, Sand Land (6 other colors sold out)
features: PERTEX UNLIMITED two-layer fabric: water-resistant, windproof and moisture-permeable, with full seam design
Slightly loose cut for movement and layering; double-flap placket; two-way front zip; zippered inner security pocket
products.golf_note: The rain-day option. A cotton-like face that looks like a normal jacket in the clubhouse, but sheds a January drizzle and the wind off the back nine.

products.name: Kel Mid Jacket
features: POLARTEC Alpha Direct high-loft fleece for warmth with breathability; Octa panels at collar, body, underarms and cuffs
Regular fit for unrestricted movement; flatlock seams; quick-drying; thumbhole cuffs
products.golf_note: Active insulation built to be worn while moving, so it breathes on the walk between shots instead of steaming up. Put a wind shell over it and a cold dawn round is handled.

products.name: POLARTEC Fleece Jacket
products.stock: In stock: Lunar Gray 3-5, Black 4-5 (Dove sold out)
features: Midweight POLARTEC 200 fleece; quick-drying, easy care
Two-way front zip, zippered side pockets with mesh bags that vent when opened; high stand collar
products.golf_note: Classic full-zip fleece with a high collar for a windy tee box. Zipped pockets keep tees and a ball marker from falling out on the cart path.

products.name: Mesh Pile Crew
products.stock: In stock: After Dark, Rose Taupe, Wolf Gray all in 2-5
products.colors: After Dark, Rose Taupe, Wolf Gray
features: Pile-texture yarn knitted in a mesh structure for warmth, breathability and quick drying
WHOLEGARMENT seamless knitting for stretch with no seams; thumbhole cuffs with fold-back rib
products.golf_note: A technical sweater that looks like a sweater. Seamless knit means nothing binds across the shoulders, and the mesh build dries out by the turn.

products.name: Nimble Tech Tapered Pants
features: Double-woven stretch fabric, windproof, water-repellent for light rain; stretch without polyurethane for durability
Larger inseam gusset, looser hip-to-thigh, slacks-like taper; zippered security pocket and zippered yoke pocket with key loop
products.golf_note: The pick of the pants for golf: a clean slacks look, a big gusset for squatting to read a putt, wind blocking for January, and a zippered pocket for the car key.

Single tuck with tapered ankle-length hem; zippered security pocket inside right waist pocket; hook-type buckle
products.golf_note: A pleated, ankle-length trouser that reads as golf-course-smart, with stretch and water repellency for wet morning grass.

products.name: One Tuck Light Stretch Shorts
products.stock: In stock: Sand Land 4-5, Ebony Gray 2, Black 2-5

Above-knee one-tuck cut; elastic waist with drawcord and belt loops; right waist security zipper pocket

products.name: All Direction Light Cap
products.stock: Limited: Black only in stock (one size)
features: Thin double-weave stretch fabric with excellent stretch and breathability; skin side releases sweat so it does not get sticky
Water repellent for light rain; buckle-type adjuster with elastic tape ends
products.golf_note: A six-panel that stretches, breathes and shrugs off drizzle. Sweat release on the inside is the part you notice on hole 14.
